# Definition 
A **urinary tract infection** (UTI) is an infection of any segment of the urinary tract from the kidneys to the bladder outlet/urethra. 

# Diagnosis 
Clinical if following symptoms present: 
1) Newly onset urinary urgency/frequency and urinary leakage
2) Fever 

If no fever, 
2) Positive leukocyte esterase on UA

# Treatment 
If patient overall stable, give oral TMP-SMX or nitrofurantoin if pregnant/on warfarin.
